purpose: Turn recovered CoZillion+ and CoAllBloom+ operator families into bounded, source-linked challenge cases for the existing WorkID/CoWalkaway frontier. One truth, two views.

baseline.evidence_scope: User-scoped X2 private readproof, four local tests and local receipt hash; raw private artifact is not republished here.

families.label: Truth and uncertainty
families.why: Separate evidence, absence, observation, interpretation and alternatives

families.label: Structure and substitution
families.why: Simplify dependencies and discover compatible alternatives

families.label: Coordination and ownership
families.why: Parallelize proposals without multiplying effect authority

families.label: Time and recovery
families.why: Preserve exact continuity through staleness, interruption and no-change

families.label: Stress and self-critique
families.why: Use bounded failures to challenge both results and test methods

families.label: Receivers and representation
families.why: Keep one truth accessible in several media and contexts

families.label: Care and useful selection
families.why: Prioritize independent benefit while reducing coercion, cost and burden

patterns.label: Null/unknown
patterns.plain: Keep unknown, absent, false and withheld as distinct states.
patterns.probe: Erase the ACK but retain the result. Does status become UNKNOWN rather than SUCCESS?
patterns.boundary: Unknown cannot grant a write.

patterns.label: Inversion
patterns.plain: Reverse assumptions, direction or viewpoint to locate a hidden dependency.
patterns.probe: Ask what fails if the source appears successful but the receiver never applied it.
patterns.boundary: Inverse is a question, not a proof.

patterns.label: Orthogonal alternative
patterns.plain: Try a different path beyond yes/no or winner/loser.
patterns.probe: Find a useful first task that needs neither a central dispatcher nor a new AI session.
patterns.boundary: Alternative is not automatically superior.

patterns.label: Falsifier
patterns.plain: Define evidence that would disprove a claimed success.
patterns.probe: Deliberately show that a generated green dashboard has no receiver-origin result.
patterns.boundary: Refutation must be reproducible.

patterns.label: Factor into shared primitives
patterns.plain: Remove duplicated mechanics while preserving site-specific facts.
patterns.probe: Replace two identical retry implementations with one versioned idempotency contract.
patterns.boundary: Never propagate a site's privacy facts.

patterns.label: Decouple failure domains
patterns.plain: Remove an unnecessary dependency while preserving essential contracts.
patterns.probe: Disable a catalogue; confirm a pinned first-use tool still works.
patterns.boundary: Loaded-page survival differs from cold independent hosting.

patterns.label: Substitute providers or components
patterns.plain: Prove one component can replace another without a silent capability loss.
patterns.probe: Recover the same public task from another host using pinned bytes and rights proof.
patterns.boundary: An equivalent URL is not an independent failure domain.

patterns.label: Compose cautiously
patterns.plain: Connect two qualified primitives through typed input/output and failure boundaries.
patterns.probe: Compose source readproof plus fenced local queue, with ACK held separate.
patterns.boundary: Composed parts do not automatically inherit authority.

patterns.label: Fan-out proposals
patterns.plain: Generate independent candidate work while one actor owns each colliding effect.
patterns.probe: Challenge one WorkID using evidence, privacy and accessibility lenses in parallel.
patterns.boundary: Many proposals do not mean many live workers.

patterns.label: Fan-in with dissent
patterns.plain: Dedupe exact proposals and preserve genuine disagreement.
patterns.probe: Same WorkID and source digest collapse; different payload stays CONFLICT.
patterns.boundary: Never use newest-wins for authority.

patterns.label: Fenced lease
patterns.plain: Bind a writer to exact WorkID, source, owner, epoch and expiry.
patterns.probe: Complete once at epoch 1, then reject a stale finisher.
patterns.boundary: Local SQLite DONE is not external ACK.

patterns.label: Single contested cut
patterns.plain: Identify the smallest shared resource that must be serialized.
patterns.probe: Allow independent site pages; hold two edits to one shared sitemap.
patterns.boundary: Serializing collision does not block all other work.

patterns.label: Event sourcing / receipts
patterns.plain: Record durable cause, effect and replay conditions instead of depending on a live tab.
patterns.probe: Restart from committed source and result without relying on the preceding chat.
patterns.boundary: A log is not an effect by itself.

patterns.label: Idempotent replay
patterns.plain: The same input and WorkID should not create a second effect.
patterns.probe: Run the same verified local source audit again and require zero new writes.
patterns.boundary: External idempotency still needs a real receiver test.

patterns.label: Currentness and expiry
patterns.plain: Expire stale observations without erasing their historical evidence.
patterns.probe: Advance the clock without new source bytes; status must become STALE.
patterns.boundary: Interpreted-at time is not source-observed time.

patterns.label: Quiescence / wake
patterns.plain: Sleep when no useful authorized delta exists; wake only for qualified triggers.
patterns.probe: Re-run unchanged evidence and require no new output or human interrupt.
patterns.boundary: Sleep must not swallow an owed deadline.

patterns.label: Bounded fault injection
patterns.plain: Introduce one controlled failure to reveal a missing recovery path.
patterns.probe: Kill a test process after durable claim but before simulated acknowledgment.
patterns.boundary: Do not fault-inject production without authority.

patterns.label: Metamorphic testing
patterns.plain: Change something that should not affect the result, then check invariants.
patterns.probe: Reverse proposal arrival order; deduped fan-in must be identical.
patterns.boundary: A passing synthetic invariant is not a human outcome.

patterns.label: Bounded recursive review
patterns.plain: Challenge the work, then challenge the challenger with a finite stop.
patterns.probe: At review depth three, stop under the two-level challenge budget.
patterns.boundary: Recursion cannot renew an expired lease.

patterns.label: Adversarial disagreement
patterns.plain: Hold inconsistent variants instead of averaging unsupported claims.
patterns.probe: Two model proposals assert different result bytes under one WorkID.
patterns.boundary: Votes by synthetic personas are not independent witnesses.

patterns.label: Receiver-relative projection
patterns.plain: Render one evidence object for text, Orb, phone or machine readers.
patterns.probe: Human status and machine JSON show the same HOLD, source and scope.
patterns.boundary: Rendering never changes source truth.

patterns.label: Accessible equivalence
patterns.plain: Provide keyboard, text, reduced-motion and compact-view equivalents.
patterns.probe: Complete one first-use task using keyboard on reduced-motion mobile.
patterns.boundary: Viewport emulation is not screen-reader acceptance.

patterns.label: Translation with loss ledger
patterns.plain: Preserve original meaning when changing language, medium or substrate.
patterns.probe: Make every simplified/glyph wording trace to a source claim and named loss.
patterns.boundary: Fictional CoIGF is not actual ET translation.

patterns.label: Typed interstice
patterns.plain: Notice gaps between events without inferring consent or private intent.
patterns.probe: An absent click or long pause must not authorize a WorkID.
patterns.boundary: Dwell and silence are not consent.

patterns.label: Benefit vector
patterns.plain: Choose on verified utility, proof, independence, fairness, cost and reversibility.
patterns.probe: Prefer a cheap source repair over ten agent sessions with no useful result.
patterns.boundary: Do not collapse welfare to an uncalibrated single score.

patterns.label: G_dSide stewardship lens
patterns.plain: Test care, non-coercion, consent, protection and benefit without mystical proof claims.
patterns.probe: Compare a user-calming HOLD with a false urgent notification.
patterns.boundary: Philosophy is not authority or empirical discovery.

patterns.label: Retirement and metabolize
patterns.plain: Retire stale or duplicative branches while keeping their lineage retrievable.
patterns.probe: Mark an unused watcher proposal dormant without destroying the prior proof.
patterns.boundary: Retirement is not deletion or supersession without authority.

patterns.label: Do-nothing counterfactual
patterns.plain: Ask whether acting produces more value than a correctly quiet state.
patterns.probe: If the source remains identical and the task is DONE, return NO_ACTION.
patterns.boundary: A no-op needs bounded evidence, not perpetual checking.

cases.title: The result exists, but nobody acknowledges it
cases.trigger: Completed local source verification; independent receiver effect unknown.
cases.next_safe: Inspect the receiver's exact WorkID and source digest before considering any retry.
cases.blocked: Never equate a producer receipt or an X2 read with the target receiver's ACK.

cases.title: A task arrives twice
cases.trigger: Same WorkID and identical source is proposed again.
cases.next_safe: Read back the original committed result; issue no duplicate write.
cases.blocked: Do not restart a completed external effect merely because a webhook repeats.

cases.title: Source changed while the work was in flight
cases.trigger: A pinned source digest no longer matches the candidate payload.
cases.next_safe: HOLD the old WorkID and propose a separately reviewed successor source.
cases.blocked: Never silently replace the payload for an existing approved WorkID.

cases.title: Two workers both claim the same effect
cases.trigger: Conflicting variants target a shared sitemap or other colliding resource.
cases.next_safe: Retain both proposals and elect one authorized writer, or hold.
cases.blocked: Last-write-wins and synthetic review votes do not convey authority.

cases.title: The central provider disappears
cases.trigger: Discovery coordinator or original publisher is not reachable.
cases.next_safe: Cold-start a source-pinned first task on an independently authorized receiver.
cases.blocked: A GitHub-runner file:// boot does not prove second-provider recovery.

cases.title: Nothing has changed
cases.trigger: Source and exact result remain current and already verified.
cases.next_safe: Return an evidenced no-op, then sleep until a qualified change.
cases.blocked: Do not manufacture work or interrupt a person merely to keep a session alive.

cases.title: A newcomer cannot complete the first useful task
cases.trigger: A site is attractive but the user cannot find what it actually does.
cases.next_safe: Test one plain-language first-use path against an incumbent and notebook baseline.
cases.blocked: Decoration, glyphs and agent metadata cannot substitute for a usable service.

cases.title: The possibility tree becomes the project
cases.trigger: More candidate labels and AI sessions appear than independently useful outcomes.
cases.next_safe: Select one high-value reversible test; leave other relations addressable, not active.
cases.blocked: Infinite addressability does not authorize infinite recursion, compute or effects.

operational_rule: ADDRESSABLE_RELATIONS_NE_ACTIVE_WORKERS; operator suggestions are test hypotheses, not commands or authority.

evaluation_limits.browser_test: Tested UI parity, keyboard and viewport if hosted CI green; not independent humans.
evaluation_limits.program_test: Deterministic registry and negative fixture checks, no real actuators.
evaluation_limits.privacy: No private directories, credentials, raw user messages or account data in this public registry.
evaluation_limits.release: Source commit and GitHub Pages readback are not CoEx, owner receiver pickup or canon.
